This is the documented origin of the on_*/_emit_* -> prepare_*/_prepare_* method-shape split; the same 'prepare seam' language appears verbatim in the current source's own docstrings (e.g. prepare_swing_confirmed: 'identical validation/candidate-computation logic as on_swing_confirmed used to perform inline, but stops BEFORE allocating any Feature ref').
